authority: Jeremy directed use of the existing syllabus, papers and examiner reports and learning from existing subject profiles. No teacher-access requirement or additional two-topic authoring trial is introduced.
review_policy: Use official 6136 syllabus and assessment evidence, automated checks and cross-vendor semantic review. No additional two-topic trial or blanket teacher-access gate. Keep actual unresolved source/technical limitations visible.

profile_pattern_provenance.adopt: Explicit fieldwork procedure, sampling choice, resource interpretation, feasible improvements and suitable representations.
profile_pattern_provenance.boundary: Do not inherit Geography paper structure, case-study rules, AO percentages or point-mark assumptions.

profile_pattern_provenance.adopt: Evidence-supported relationships, developed causal reasoning, necessary conditions and discriminating conceptual boundaries.
profile_pattern_provenance.boundary: Do not import Economics theories, essay tariffs or mark-scheme authority into 6136.

profile_pattern_provenance.adopt: Context must affect reasoning; a judgement names its criterion, alternative and the condition that could change it.
profile_pattern_provenance.boundary: Do not force every development answer into profit, business stakeholder or extended evaluation templates.

profile_pattern_provenance.adopt: Ordered methods, numerical precision, practical limitations and improvement linked to the source of error.
profile_pattern_provenance.boundary: Do not import Biology content, experimental assumptions, AO allocation or MCQ practice.
